content: We have functional groups list includes "sulfonamides", "acyl chloride". So we can search for templates that break sulfonamide (i.e., forward reaction forms sulfonamide). In retrosynthesis, we want to break sulfonamide bond, so functional_groups_broken in forward reaction would be "sulfonamides". functional_groups_formed would be "acyl chloride"? Actually forward reaction: sulfonyl chloride + amine -> sulfonamide (forms sulfonamide, consumes acyl chloride). So broken group: "acyl chloride"? Wait forward reaction: acyl chloride (sulfonyl chloride) is consumed, not broken. The bond formed is S-N. The functional group formed is sulfonamide. So we set functional_groups_formed = "sulfonamides". functional_groups_broken maybe "acyl chloride". Let's try search.
